body: I glance at the communal board in surprise, noticing a second key peeking out among the usual locks and files. My initial anger gives way to curiosity as I pick up the note beside it—my name written in a bold, threatening pen script. The message reads, "Welcome back, Detective." My heart races; this isn't just another misplaced key.
